scope: Exploratory fixed finite-box Binder locators within strong staggered-nematic response. All start/half/threshold/interpolation families retained, including failures. Anchor brackets and variant unions are descriptive, not calibrated confidence intervals or thermodynamic estimates. Pooling never removes incompatible starts. No assumed universality or fitted asymptote.
